item.title: The Beauty of Artists' Studios
item.description:
📝 The centrepiece was a tinkling fountain and impluvium, complete with goldfish. ‘When painters depict painters, they often bring their best game’ A new show, Magic and Mess: The Artist’s Studio Revealed, which will be in the exhibition space until March next year, puts Leighton House in context, with 56 paintings, drawings and albumen photographic prints depicting artists’ studios from the long 19th-century. They rotate between being stored at her research facility, going on loan, and hanging on the walls of her home, not far from Leighton House.
